thread:
josh_customer: Hey team — starting ~02:10 UTC we're getting a spike of 422s for tool calls in prod for several customers (acme-inc, beta-shop). Example error returned from /v1/tool/invoke:
```json
{
  \"error\": \"tool_call_validation_failed\",
  \"details\": [
    {\"path\": \"args.payment.amount\", \"message\": \"expected number, got string\"}
  ],
  \"request_id\": \"rq_ABC123XYZ\"
}
```
Request id above is from one failed request. We haven't changed client code recently (customer claims no deploy), but saw a surge at ~02:09. Any quick mitigation? Impacting billing workflow.

alex_support: Thanks Josh. Can you paste a sanitized request body for one of the failing calls and the full request id? Also which tool name/version did the router pick (tool_id)?

josh_customer: Pasting a redacted payload (sensitive fields removed) + request id:
```
POST /v1/tool/invoke
{
  "tool": "charge_customer",
  "args": "{\"payment\":{\"amount\":\"1200\",\"currency\":\"USD\"},\"method\":\"card\"}",
  "user_id": "acct_9876"
}
```
request_id: rq_ABC123XYZ

alex_support: ah — I can see the problem in that payload: args is a string containing JSON (double-encoded). Our validator expects args to be an object, so numbers inside become strings. Can you confirm whether the client is sending args as a JSON string intentionally? Maybe front-end did JSON.stringify twice.

sara_engineer: Flagging to eng-runtime. @alex_support this will map to a schema mismtach path. Two quick follow-ups:
- Can you grab the router logs for rq_ABC123XYZ (trace id) and paste the tool selection metadata? I want to see whether the router coerced types or just passed through.
- If you have an example client commit or release timestamp for acme-inc, share that.

alex_support: Router log snippet (sanitized):
```
[2024-06-20T02:09:43Z] rq_ABC123XYZ selected_tool=charge_customer:v2.1.0 args_type=string args_len=176
[...]
validation: failed path=args.payment.amount expected=number actual=string
```

alex_support: Short mitigation ideas:
- Temporary: enable per-customer preprocessor that attempts JSON.parse if args is a string (coerce). We can toggle via feature flag for acme-inc.
- If not safe, disable automated tool invocation for that customer (return structured fallback to caller so they can call tool manually).

josh_customer: We can toggle the flag on our side, but acme says their SDK didn't change. I'm going to ask them to check whether any proxy or SDK wrapper rolled out an update that stringifies args.

sara_engineer: Repro steps for engineering to validate locally (minimal):
JS client that double-encodes args:
```js
const payload = {
  tool: 'charge_customer',
  args: JSON.stringify({ payment: { amount: 1200, currency: 'USD' }, method: 'card' })
};
fetch('/v1/tool/invoke', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
// server receives args as a string -> schema validation fails
```
Also test with a proper object:
```js
const payload = { tool: 'charge_customer', args: { payment: { amount: 1200, currency: 'USD' }, method: 'card' } }
```

incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-20240620-87 (tools-schema-errors). Pagerduty notified. https://incidents/internal/INC-20240620-87

sara_engineer: Engineering next steps (assigning to eng-runtime):
- Add a safe parsing attempt for top-level args when type==string (log original payload and parsed result) behind a feature flag. (safety: only attempt once, do not mutate if ambiguous)
- Increase logging at validation failure points to include args_type and tool_id.
- Add a regression test that ensures numeric fields are validated when args originally arrive as strings.

alex_support: For immediate customer support: I applied a per-tenant flag to attempt JSON.parse on args for acme-inc at 02:25 UTC. Monitoring now.

josh_customer: Confirming — acme reported errors dropped immediately after the flag.

sara_engineer: Good. I'll create a follow-up PR for opt-in safe-coercion in the router with telemetry and a clear opt-out. Also we should update docs to call out that args must be structured JSON (no double-encoded strings) and add a diagnostic hint in the 422 response when args is a string.

alex_support: Noted. Closing the support ticket once PR is merged and we have a changelog entry. Thanks all :thumbsup!:
